page.overview:
Who is Mike?

Mike is a security guard at an old Freddy Fazbear's Pizza. He appeared in You're the Band, the third story of Fazbear Frights 12: Felix the Shark.

Sylvia describes Mike as a young Caucasian man in his early twenties, wearing shorts and a T-shirt. His appearance akin to that of an college student.

Mike was hired as a security guard at an abandoned Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, the same location where a tragic incident occurred thirty years prior to the events of You're the Band. He is seemingly aware that the animatronics are possessed.

Weeks before the story takes place, Freddy's was broken into and multiple items were stolen, one of them being Freddy Fazbear's mask.
